messages:
sam (Support): FYI customer hit repeated 400s on function/tool call. Says schema validation failed. Request ID: req-20260317-9f1a. Can someone grab logs and a curl repro?

maria (SRE): Got it. Any quick sample payload they used?

sam (Support): They pasted this snippet in their ticket: `{'tool': 'invoice_extractor', 'input': 'pdf bytes...', 'params': {'mode': 'structured'}}` then the API returned 400 with body `ValidationError: /tool_response/items: required property missing`

jordan (ML Eng): That path suggests the tool returned a top-level object missing `items` array expected by our schema. Could be model hallucinated a truncated `fn_call` result. Need the exact request headers (auth + X-Request-ID) and response body.

sam (Support): I asked for the full response; customer uploaded a screenshot but not raw response. Asked them to run curl with header. Leaving a quick repro template here for them: 

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req-20260317-9f1a-cust" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-tool-1","input":"<base64-pdf>","tool_call": {"name":"invoice_extractor","schema_version":"2026-02-01"}}'
```

maria (SRE): If they run that, ask them to include `--trace-ascii /dev/stderr` or capture HTTP debug so we get wire traces. Also requesting their `request_id` exactly as returned by our API (sometimes our gateway rewrites).

leo (Support): Customer replied with their run and included header `X-Request-ID: req-20260317-9f1a-cust` and response status 400. Paste of body: 

```json
{"error":"ValidationError","message":"/tool_response/items: required property missing","request_id":"req-20260317-9f1a-cust","model":"redwood-tool-1-v2"}
```

jordan (ML Eng): Thanks. Can we get the raw tool output that was validated? The error implies our schema validator ran after tool parsing. Two possible causes: 1) model returned `tool_response` as string instead of object, 2) tool returned object but omitted `items`.

maria (SRE): I'm spinning up a trace on the gateway for `req-20260317-9f1a-cust`. Ops-bot: any spikes?

ops-bot: Alert: 5xx spike on region-us-west between 10:41:20 and 10:47:00 UTC. 12 total 502s, correlated with ML-pool-3.

maria (SRE): Noted. Jordan, can you check if redwood-tool-1-v2 has any recent code change to output shape? Also, need model-side logs (kv cache, truncated completion).

jordan (ML Eng): Checking. No recent changes to tool code. Hypothesis: token truncation caused function output cutoff so JSON ended up invalid. If the validator sees partial JSON, it can throw the path error. Ask customer to re-run with `max_tokens` bumped or `stop` ensured.

sam (Support): Sent instructions to customer to re-run with the curl above plus "max_tokens": 2048 and "stop": "\n\n--END--". Also asked them to include the response body and exact status/headers.

leo (Support): They ran and attached a debug bundle link: https://files.redwood.example/debug/req-20260317-9f1a-cust-blob.tar.gz (they used redact=auto). Bundle includes gateway.log, model_proxy.log, and response.json.

maria (SRE): Downloading bundle. Quick grep shows model_proxy.log includes this snippet around the req id:

```
[2026-03-17T10:42:10Z] req=req-20260317-9f1a-cust model=redwood-tool-1-v2 recv=\"{\"tool_response\": \"{\\\"items\\\": [\\\"inv_123\\\"]\"}\"
```

maria (SRE): Aha — looks like tool_response got double-encoded as a string, so the validator saw `tool_response` as string instead of object. That would cause the required property missing path.

jordan (ML Eng): That matches a recent edge case where the model backend was returning JSON as a single string when tool call went through streaming + chunk concat. We have a fix in a branch to post-process stringified JSON into objects when safe.

sam (Support): Great find. What's the mitigation for customer now?

jordan (ML Eng): Short term: we can add a server-side pre-validator that tries to JSON.parse string fields at `tool_response` before schema validation — toggleable per-customer. Long-term: fix the streaming concat to emit proper JSON objects.

maria (SRE): I'll attach the gateway trace and the exact `response.json` to the ticket. Also adding `internal_fix_toggle=true` for this req in our internal debug console to test parse.

leo (Support): Customer confirmed that after we applied the parse-fix flag, the same curl returned 200 and parsed `items` correctly.

sam (Support): Closing loop with customer; they want a permanent fix and a postmortem. Jordan, can you own the rollout?

jordan (ML Eng): Yep — will PR the concat fix and schedule a canary tomorrow. I'll also add a unit test covering stringified tool_response.

maria (SRE): I'll prepare a short incident note and link the debug bundle + gateway traces.

sam (Support): Thanks all. I'll update ticket and mark as resolved once PR is merged and canary passes. :thumbsup:
